_comment: Mutation survivors accepted as a baseline for the walk sweep. The nightly ratchet fails when a survivor appears outside this set, and when an entry is no longer a survivor. Regenerate with `python scripts/mutation_gate.py --baseline walk --update` after a sweep, and only ever let this set shrink. Entries are the survivor line without its line:col position, so they survive unrelated code motion.
_timeouts_comment: All three entries are TIMEOUTS rather than judged survivors, and they share one cause: each deletes a short-circuit, so the recursion-depth case (a 130-level chain through a two-branch union) does exponential redundant work and the run never returns a verdict. A mutant whose experiment cannot finish is a rig fault, not a detection, so the ratchet counts it as a survivor -- the conservative direction. None of the three can change a verdict: each only removes an early return or lets a discarded sub-walk aggregate into a buffer nothing reads. Killing them would need a corpus that reaches the same arms without the deep case, which is work with no soundness behind it.
survivors: crates/valgebra-py/src/check/walk.rs: delete field mode from struct Ctx expression in fast
